findings.finding: The callback supplied to VerifiedResourceSampler invokes state['_pulse'](). In the frozen C4 consumer, _pulse is the full resource/Power guard, not an original clock-only callback. A separate sampler instance avoids direct self-recursion but does not satisfy the required clock-only integration contract.
findings.source_counterexample: A sampling _check invokes resource_checkpoint; that invokes the C4 full guard, which may perform its own OS RSS observation and update its prior successful-resource timestamp while the coordinator sample and its memory caps are still in progress.
findings.minimum_correction: Use a separately named mandatory original-origin clock-only state hook with no RSS/heartbeat/last-success update, while retaining the existing full _pulse call in the outer supervisor loop. Keep common/parent deadline checks and the original prior observation/gap state. No fallback to the full guard is allowed.

conclusion: CHANGES_REQUIRED_VSC01; this frozen source is not accepted for consumer integration
preservation: Preserve ae471/52d1 and this finding; review the separately authorized source revision without relabelling this snapshot or any old BRQ failure
